notice.What: Descriptive sample-level QC within explicitly declared batches. Each included subject contributes at most one sample per batch; subjects may recur across batches, so batch summaries are not independent. Modified z = 0.6745 * (transformed value - median) / raw MAD, including the observation in its reference batch. Absolute scores strictly above the declared threshold are review flags, not p-values, calibrated error rates, bad-sample diagnoses or biological effects. Small groups and zero MAD remain unscored, with no epsilon or pooled-batch fallback. Positive abundance and retained-row metrics use log10 without pseudocounts; fractions use their original scale. Missing values are unavailable, not zero. Most observations in each batch must form a meaningful reference: systematic batch failure, heterogeneity, biological confounding and masking can evade or distort flags. Inspect the common-scale distributions and exclusions. No sample is removed and no batch correction or causal inference is performed.

limits: Exact replay from captured sample QC measurements only. Source files and the extraction of sample metrics are not independently verified. Batch medians, MADs and descriptive flags are recomputed; flags do not establish contamination or justify automatic correction. Matching bytes do not establish authorship or scientific validity. Captured evidence is not de-identified.
